apps.name: EZCompleteUI
apps.subtitle: AI chat, images, voice and games
apps.localizedDescription:
EZCompleteUI is a native iOS AI workspace with coin-metered chat, a gallery-first image studio, transcription, text-to-speech and ElevenLabs voice cloning, searchable memories, and a custom game creator.

• Persistent chats with local history, file and image attachments, and inline previews
• Image generation and multi-image AI editing from a built-in photo gallery
• Whisper transcription, Apple and ElevenLabs text-to-speech, and a TTS library with audio editing
• AI memory: conversations are summarized and searchable
• BrainRot game creator with saved and community games
• Free coins every 6 hours, with optional coin purchases

An account is required to use the app. Source code and FAQ: github.com/Tweaker177/EZCompleteUI

versions.localizedDescription:
## What’s new

- Upgraded the balanced chat model to GPT-6.1 Sol and removed GPT-5.6 Luna.
- Added safer large image batches for chat: attach up to 15 images, with automatic JPEG conversion and only the downscaling needed to stay within the upload budget.
- Added Solidity (`.sol`) and broad common source-file support for chat attachments and iOS Open In.
- Prevented true duplicate gallery images when attaching existing gallery items to chat.
- Added AI-powered gallery analysis and tailored Surprise Me edit recipes.
- Refined the Music Video Workshop audio-attachment prompt to match the app UI.
- Improved TTS clip recovery, library playback, and voice selection.
- Added campaign-segment and marketing-opt-in database migrations.

## Compatibility

- Requires iOS 15.0 or later.
- Includes a signed IPA and a rootless arm64 DEB.

## Gallery
- Add Ask AI a Question to the multi-select menu; all selected images attach to the chat composer.
- Replace the plain system action menu with a themed selected-media card.
- Speed up gallery opening with background indexing, reusable thumbnails, and direct thumbnail decoding.

## Ricochet
- Keep all five main performance controls, including Saturation, visible in one row.
- Dismiss successful high-score name entry automatically so the updated leaderboard is immediately visible.

## Interface
- Restore visible Copy, Speak, and Memories controls in the main chat header.

Added a lot more to the new musical Brainrot game, including a smarrt keyboard, midi drum sequences, more knobs you can control like modulation, compression, high and lowpass, etc.  You can now select the wave type with each synth node, choose square, triangle, sawtooth, sine.  

The game is midi compliant and sends a clock and notes to channel 10.  Use with other midi instruments and it will play the keyboard and drums in other apps.  Pretty cool.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tweaker177/EZCompleteUI/compare/v7.1.4...v7.1.5
